$comment: #648. Data only, read by packages/tools/dev/benchmark.mjs. Cold start (a fresh process) time and peak resident memory per check, compared against the median of the runs. Numbers are deliberately generous first budgets (roughly 2 to 4 times what a 16 GB development machine measures) so that only a real regression trips them; tighten them from benchmark output, never from a guess. The measured numbers the docs quote are in benchmark-snapshot.json.
